modules.title: 样式作用在哪些对象上

items.title: 通过类名找到对象
items.text: WXML 中的 class="reserve" 把按钮连到 WXSS 的 .reserve。同一个类名也可以统一设置多个相同对象的样式。

items.title: 样式有作用范围
items.text: app.wxss 提供全局页面样式，页面同名的 WXSS 负责当前页。自定义组件还可能隔离自己的样式。

modules.title: 按钮变色，能修复保存失败吗
modules.text: 按钮变色不能修复预约保存失败。样式没生效时要检查类名、组件隔离和平台支持范围，不能假设它与浏览器 CSS 完全一样。

lessonPractice.title: 预约按钮已经能正常保存，现在只想改背景色和圆角。应主要改哪里？

options.label: 在 WXSS 中修改对应的样式
options.feedback: 这是外观改动；保留现有行为，并确认它仍正常。

options.label: 在 WXML 中重新搭一遍按钮结构
options.feedback: 按钮结构已经存在，颜色和圆角不需要通过重建它来改变。

options.label: 在 JavaScript 中修改预约保存函数
options.feedback: 保存函数已经正常工作，不负责这两个静态外观属性。

en.title: The booking button saves correctly. Only its background and corners need changing. Which file is responsible?

options.label: Change the matching styles in WXSS
options.feedback: This is an appearance change; retain and verify the existing action.

options.label: Rebuild the button structure in WXML
options.feedback: Structure is already present; rebuilding it is unnecessary for these style properties.

options.label: Change the booking save handler in JavaScript
options.feedback: The save handler is already working and does not own these static styles.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 可以这样发给项目里的 AI Agent

en.title: Send this to the AI Agent in your project
en.text: Style the booking button in this WeChat page’s WXSS using the project theme color and existing corner and spacing rules. Keep its label, placement, and click handler. Check narrow and wide screens and complete a booking to verify the behavior.

items.title: A class connects component and style
items.text: class="reserve" connects the WXML button to .reserve in WXSS. The same class can style several matching objects.

items.title: Styles have a scope
items.text: app.wxss provides app-wide page styles; the page’s WXSS styles that page. Custom components may isolate their styles.

modules.title: Can styling fix a failed save?
modules.text: A color change cannot fix a failed save. Check component style isolation and platform support when a selector does not apply; do not assume all browser CSS behaves identically.

distinctions.label: WXML
distinctions.text: Declares which components exist. WXSS styles those components.

distinctions.label: CSS
distinctions.text: WXSS borrows many CSS conventions and adds units such as rpx. Platform support must be checked rather than assuming full browser compatibility.
